title: Question Words
description: Basic question words and question formation
descriptionRussian: Основные вопросительные слова и построение вопросов
intro: Question words help you ask about people, things, places, time, and reasons. Russian question words include кто (who), что (what), где (where), когда (when), почему (why), and как (how). Unlike English, Russian doesn't require special word order for questions - you can often just add a question word or change your intonation.
rules: Кто? (Who?) and Что? (What?) ask about people and things in nominative case.
Где? (Where?) asks about location. Куда? (Where to?) asks about direction/destination. Откуда? (Where from?) asks about origin.
Когда? (When?), Почему? (Why?), and Как? (How?) ask about time, reason, and manner.
Word order in questions is flexible: «Где ты живёшь?» = «Ты где живёшь?» Both are correct.
examples: Кто это? — Это Анна. (Who is this?, This is Anna.)
Что ты читаешь? — Книгу. (What are you reading?, A book.)
Где ты живёшь? — В Москве. (Where do you live?, In Moscow.)
Когда ты придёшь? — Завтра. (When will you come?, Tomorrow.)

items.promptEnglish: Who is this? - This is my friend.
items.explanation: Кто (Who) is used when asking about people.

items.promptEnglish: What is this? - This is a book.
items.explanation: Что (What) is used when asking about things.

items.promptEnglish: Where do you live? - In Moscow.
items.explanation: Где (Where) asks about location. The answer uses в + prepositional.

items.promptEnglish: Where are you going? - To the store.
items.explanation: Куда (Where to) asks about direction. The answer uses в + accusative.

items.promptEnglish: Where did you come from? - From Petersburg.
items.explanation: Откуда (Where from) asks about origin. The answer uses из + genitive.

items.prompt: _____ ты не пришёл? — Я был болен. (Why)
items.promptEnglish: Why didn't you come? - I was sick.
items.explanation: Почему (Why) asks about the reason for something.

blanks: _____ тебя зовут? — Меня зовут Анна. (How = What's your name?)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: Russian uses 'how' (как) to ask names: Как тебя зовут?

minimalPairs.explanation: Где asks about current location. Куда asks about direction/destination.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Where are you going? - To school.
minimalPairs.explanation: Куда asks about direction/destination. Где asks about location.

categorySorting.instruction: Sort question words by what they ask about

reviewVocab.example: Где ты? Куда идёшь? Откуда ты?
